'''Jenna Zan Arbor's apartment''' was an apartment located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] tower. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] it was owned by [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who was working for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. It was large, taking up the whole floor of one of the tower's upper levels. It overlooked the space lanes of the Galactic City and had a large terrace. It also had a small, windowless room in the back for [[Linna Naltree]], a forced assistant of Zan Arbor.

The same year street kid [[Trever Flume]], a friend of ex-Jedi [[Ferus Olin]], infiltrated the apartment using small grenades. He was looking for a datapad or anything else with information about Zan Arbor. He left after meeting [[Ry-Gaul]], an ex-Jedi who also had broken into the apartment.
